#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

bool check_property(const vector<int>& f, int p, int k) {
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (f[(k * i) % p] != (k * f[i]) % p) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int enumerate_f(vector<int>& f, int p, int k, int index) {
    if (index == p) {
        return check_property(f, p, k) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    int total = 0;
    for (int val = 0; val < p; ++val) {
        f.push_back(val);
        total += enumerate_f(f, p, k, index + 1);
        f.pop_back();
    }
    return total;
}

int solve(int p, int k) {
    int total_groups = 0;
    set<int> visited;
    for (int j = 0; j < p; ++j) {
        if (visited.find(j) == visited.end()) {
            total_groups++;
        }
        int i = j;
        while (visited.find(i) == visited.end()) {
            visited.insert(i);
            i = (i * k) % p;
        }
    }
    long long mod = 1000000007;
    long long exponent = total_groups - (k != 1 ? 1 : 0);
    long long result = 1;
    for (long long i = 0; i < exponent; ++i) {
        result = (result * p) % mod;
    }
    return static_cast<int>(result);
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    cout << solve(p, k) << endl;
    return 0;
}
